finding: Orphan and superseded composition retirement deleted the hash-bound manifest before the directory. A terminal interruption could leave an empty directory without durable cleanup authority.

contract.ownership: Hash-bound orphan/superseded deletion first persists and reads back a canonical existing-format staging marker. Existing retained pointer/staging authority protects its own removal path without a redundant marker.
contract.completion: Delete admitted direct files, then remove the directory nonrecursively and observe its absence before removing the new marker. Interrupted or ambiguous operations preserve authority for later bounded cleanup.
contract.identity: Bound marker capacity and four allocation attempts. Never allocate the current active pointer's activation ID, which would make retirement resemble an unresolved active commit.
contract.coordination: Keep global writer then exclusive composition locking. Readers retain their shared leases. Unknown files/directories remain protected.
contract.unchanged: No new schema, format reader, model admission relaxation, app visual change, remote publication or model execution.

developmentResults.result: Four terminal interruption subtests and their enclosing test failed: manifest-after, directory-before, directory-after lacked a retained marker; marker-before had no marker removal to interrupt.
